title: Sailor by Massive Glacial Ice Wall, 1940s Alaska Landscape Snapshot Photo
description: A mid-20th-century black-and-white landscape snapshot depicting an immense glacial wall dropping into a body of water scattered with floating ice chunks. In the foreground on the right, a solitary figure wearing a dark uniform and a white sailor cap walks along the rocky, boulder-strewn shoreline. The scene underscores the scale of Arctic and sub-Arctic nature, likely taken by or featuring an American serviceman stationed in Alaska during or immediately following World War II.
